tim_output.campaign_summary: Black Basta is a ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) variant first identified in April 2022 that has impacted over 500 organizations globally across at least 12 of 16 critical infrastructure sectors, including healthcare. The group uses initial access techniques such as spearphishing, exploiting known vulnerabilities (including CVE-2024-1709), and social engineering campaigns involving email bombing and impersonation via Microsoft Teams to deploy remote access tools. Following initial compromise, Black Basta affiliates conduct privilege escalation, lateral movement, data exfiltration via RClone, and file encryption using ChaCha20 with RSA-4096 keys, then employ a double-extortion model by exfiltrating data and demanding ransom via Tor-hosted sites.
